explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that this duplicates. The theorem is the membership lemma for `balancedOpens`, a definition made in the library itself at line 141 of the same file. That definition is the open set `{x | f x = g x} ∩ V`, and the lemma is proved by `Iff.rfl`, so it only unfolds that definition. All of its content comes from the library's own definition, and Mathlib has no `balancedOpens` to match against. The only general facts it touches are routine ones (membership in an intersection, or in a set defined by a predicate), which do not count. I did not need a broader search, because no Mathlib declaration can state a result about a definition that exists only in this library.
